description:
Reid 2095 500W 20" eBike | Electric Cargo Commuter Bike
Combining distinctive moto-inspired styling with powerful electric performance and practical cargo-carrying features, the Reid 2095 is built for everyday journeys and more.
Inspired by Manly, Sydney's iconic 2095 postcode, the Reid 2095 brings a relaxed coastal influence to urban electric riding. Its distinctive design, integrated bench seat and practical cargo setup make it a versatile choice for commuting, shopping trips and exploring the city.
The 6061 alloy frame features a convenient step-through design for easier mounting and dismounting, with a discreetly positioned battery beneath the seat. An Ananda 500W rear hub motor delivers powerful electric assistance, with 750W peak power and 65Nm of torque to help riders tackle hills and longer journeys. The integrated 48V 15Ah (720Wh) battery offers an approximate range of up to 80 miles (130km), depending on terrain, rider weight and riding style.
Designed for comfort across different urban surfaces, the 2095 features a Uding D9 suspension fork with 80mm of travel and a lockout function. Wide 20 x 3.0" all-road tyres and durable double-walled alloy rims provide a stable ride, while the suspension fork helps absorb bumps and uneven surfaces.
Practical cargo features make the 2095 more than just a commuter eBike. An integrated front rack, with a maximum load capacity of 15kg, and a central-mounted basket provide convenient space for shopping and everyday essentials. With a maximum total payload of 150kg, it offers plenty of carrying capacity for daily use.
A Shimano 7-speed drivetrain provides flexibility across different routes and gradients, while Tektro hydraulic disc brakes with 180mm rotors deliver reliable stopping power. The Ananda DF230 colour display features Bluetooth connectivity and app compatibility, keeping essential ride information close at hand. Integrated front and rear LED lights help improve visibility when riding in different conditions.
Combining powerful electric assistance, generous carrying capacity and distinctive café racer-inspired styling, the Reid 2095 offers a practical and characterful alternative to conventional commuter eBikes.
The 2095 eBike is ideal for:

Everyday commuting, with powerful assistance from an Ananda 500W rear hub motor

Tackling hills and longer journeys, with 750W peak power and 65Nm of torque

Extended rides, with a 48V 15Ah (720Wh) battery offering an approximate range of up to 80 miles (130km)

Carrying shopping and essentials, with an integrated front rack and central-mounted basket

Easy mounting and dismounting, with a convenient step-through alloy frame

Comfort across urban surfaces, with an 80mm Uding D9 suspension fork and wide 20 x 3.0" tyres

Tackling varied routes, with a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain

Confident stopping power, with Tektro hydraulic disc brakes and 180mm rotors

Connected ride information, with a Bluetooth-enabled Ananda colour display

Carrying heavier loads, with a maximum total payload of 150kg

Range figures are estimates and will vary depending on terrain, rider weight and riding conditions. Front rack maximum load capacity: 15kg. Total payload capacity: 150kg.

Please make sure to familiarise yourself with eBike safety information before charging or using your new Reid. You can view and download user manuals and safety instructions here.

components.description: Tektro HD-E3120 hydraulic disc brakes with brake cut-off, 180mm rotors
Ananda R531 48V 500W (750W peak power) rear hub motor, 65nm

Front and rear mudguards with protective rear side skirts
Uding D9 80mm travel with lockout, QR axle
Alloy riser bar 660mm wide, 80mm rise, 25.4mm clamp

Frame mounting front rack, max loading 15kg
300X speed lever with up to 20mph assistance
